hindi: समिधा से अग्नि की सेवा करो, घृत से अतिथि को जगाओ; इसमें हव्य पदार्थों की आहुति दो।
english: Serve Agni with the kindling-stick; awaken the guest with ghee; into him offer the oblations.

hindi: भली प्रकार प्रज्वलित ज्वाला के लिए तीव्र घृत की आहुति दो, जातवेदा अग्नि के लिए।
english: To the well-kindled flame offer sharp ghee, to Agni Jātavedas.

hindi: हे अङ्गिरा, उस तुझको हम समिधाओं और घृत से बढ़ाते हैं; हे सबसे युवा, ऊँचा प्रज्वलित हो।
english: You, O Aṅgiras, we make grow with kindling-sticks and with ghee; blaze high, O youngest one.

hindi: हे अग्नि, हे प्रिय, हव्य से युक्त, घृत से भीगी (समिधाएँ) तेरे पास जाएँ; मेरी समिधाओं को स्वीकार करो।
english: Let the oblation-bearing, ghee-dripping (sticks) go to you, O Agni, O delightful one; accept my kindling-sticks.
notes: haviṣmatīḥ and ghṛtācīḥ are feminine plural adjectives whose noun (samidhaḥ, the kindling-sticks of the second half) is understood.

words.gloss: O place of worship of the gods

hindi: भूः भुवः स्वः! आकाश के समान महत्ता में, पृथिवी के समान विस्तार में — हे पृथिवी, हे देवयजनि, उस तेरी पीठ पर मैं अन्न खाने वाले अग्नि को अन्न खाने के लिए स्थापित करता हूँ।
english: Bhūḥ, bhuvaḥ, svaḥ! Like the sky in greatness, like the earth in width: O Earth, O place of worship of the gods, on the back of you, that one, I set Agni the food-eater, for the eating of food.
notes: bhūmnā and varimṇā are instrumentals of respect ("in greatness", "in width"). tasyāḥ te = "of you, that one" (demonstrative with the 2nd person pronoun).

words.gram: m. nom. sg. pres. part. pra-√i

hindi: यह चितकबरा वृषभ आगे बढ़ा है; वह माता के सामने बैठ गया है, और पिता की ओर, स्वर्ग की ओर, जाता हुआ।
english: This dappled bull has stepped forth; he has sat down before the mother, and going forth to the father, to heaven.
notes: gauḥ may be bull or cow; taken as masculine with pṛśniḥ and prayan. prayantsvaḥ: prayan + svaḥ with the inserted t of sandhi (n + s). svaḥ is read as a second object of prayan, in apposition to pitaram.

words.gram: f. nom. sg. pres. part. apa-√an

hindi: वह दीप्तिमती इसके भीतर चलती है, प्राण से बाहर श्वास छोड़ती हुई; उस महान ने आकाश को देखा।
english: The shining one moves within, breathing out from his breath; the mighty one has beheld the sky.
notes: rocanā asya: taken as "the shining one (fem.) ... of this one"; the alternative is rocanā as a feminine form "shining" qualifying an understood subject. akhyan is the Vedic 3 sg. form (classical akhyat) with mahiṣaḥ as subject. mahiṣa literally "buffalo", here "the mighty one". The input line has a double space before mahiṣo, kept in src.

hindi: वह तीस धामों पर शासन करती है; वाणी पक्षी (सूर्य) के लिए रखी जाती है, प्रत्येक प्रभात में, निश्चय ही, दिनों के साथ।
english: She rules over thirty domains; speech is set for the bird; at each dawning, indeed, with the days.

text_flags.why: the printed Devanagari त्रि॒jशद्धाम॒ contains a stray Latin letter "j" where the anusvara/Vedic anusvara sign of triṃśat ("thirty") must stand; the word triṃśad-dhāma is required by the sense (thirty domains).

notes: dhāma is taken as neuter accusative plural (Vedic) "domains". pataṅga "bird" is commonly understood of the sun, but the line only says "bird". prati vastoḥ: "at each dawning"; aha is the emphatic particle. The subject of vi rājati is the shining one of unit 7.

hindi: अग्नि ज्योति है, ज्योति अग्नि है, स्वाहा। सूर्य ज्योति है, ज्योति सूर्य है, स्वाहा। अग्नि वर्चस् है, ज्योति वर्चस् है, स्वाहा। सूर्य वर्चस् है, ज्योति वर्चस् है, स्वाहा। ज्योति सूर्य है, सूर्य ज्योति है, स्वाहा।
english: Agni is light, light is Agni, svāhā. Sūrya is light, light is Sūrya, svāhā. Agni is splendour, light is splendour, svāhā. Sūrya is splendour, light is splendour, svāhā. Light is Sūrya, Sūrya is light, svāhā.

words.gram: m. nom. sg. pres. part. mid. √juṣ
m. nom. sg. pres. part. mid. √juṣ

hindi: देव सविता के साथ, इन्द्र से युक्त रात्रि के साथ, प्रसन्न होता हुआ अग्नि (हवि का) सेवन करे, स्वाहा। देव सविता के साथ, इन्द्र से युक्त उषा के साथ, प्रसन्न होता हुआ सूर्य (हवि का) सेवन करे, स्वाहा।
english: Together with the god Savitṛ, together with Night accompanied by Indra, may Agni, accepting, enjoy (the offering), svāhā. Together with the god Savitṛ, together with Dawn accompanied by Indra, may Sūrya, accepting, enjoy (the offering), svāhā.
notes: sajū rātryā: the visarga of sajūḥ is dropped before r by regular sandhi. In line 2 the danda and juṣāṇaḥ are printed without a space ("|jṷṣā̱ṇaḥ"); kept as one src token.

words.gram: m. nom. pl. pres. part. upa-pra-√i

hindi: यज्ञ के समीप जाते हुए हम अग्नि के लिए मन्त्र बोलें, जो दूर से और हमारे बीच भी सुनता है।
english: Approaching the sacrifice, may we speak a mantra to Agni, who hears afar and among us.
notes: asme is the Vedic locative/dative plural of the 1st person pronoun; taken as locative "among us".

hindi: अग्नि स्वर्ग का सिर है, शिखर है; यह पृथिवी का स्वामी है; यह जलों के बीजों को उत्तेजित करता है।
english: Agni is the head of heaven, the summit; this one is the lord of the earth; he quickens the seeds of the waters.
notes: kakut patiḥ written together: kakut "summit, peak" and patiḥ "lord" are separate words. pṛthivyā: the visarga of pṛthivyāḥ is dropped before a- by sandhi. ᳪ in src is the Vedic anusvara sign.

hindi: हे इन्द्र और अग्नि, तुम दोनों को आह्वान के लिए (बुलाता हूँ), दोनों को दान के साथ आनन्दित होने के लिए; दोनों अन्न और धन के दाताओं को, दोनों को बल की प्राप्ति के लिए मैं बुलाता हूँ।
english: Both of you, Indra and Agni, (I call) to invoke, both to delight together in the bounty; both the givers of refreshments and of riches, both of you I call for the winning of strength.
notes: āhuvadhyā u-: the final -ai of the infinitive āhuvadhyai becomes -ā before a vowel (Vedic sandhi). rādhasaḥ saha mādayadhyai: "to delight together in (with) the bounty"; the genitive is read with mādayadhyai. vāja may be "strength" or "booty".

hindi: यह तेरा समयोचित स्थान है, जिससे उत्पन्न होकर तू चमका; हे अग्नि, उसे जानता हुआ उस पर आरूढ़ हो, फिर हमारे धन को बढ़ा।
english: This is your timely seat, from which, born, you shone; knowing it, O Agni, mount it; then make our wealth grow.
notes: agna ā-: the voc. agne loses its final -e before ā- by sandhi. ārohāthā = ā roha atha with a + a > ā; vardhayā shows metrical lengthening of vardhaya.

hindi: यह यहाँ स्थापकों द्वारा प्रथम स्थापित किया गया, होता, श्रेष्ठ याजक, यज्ञों में स्तुत्य; जिसे अप्नवान और भृगुओं ने वनों में प्रकाशित किया, उज्ज्वल, व्यापक, प्रत्येक प्रजा के लिए।
english: This one was here set first by the establishers as the hotṛ, best at sacrifice, to be praised at the rites; whom Apnavāna and the Bhṛgus made shine in the woods, bright, pervading, for every clan.
notes: apnavānaḥ is taken as a proper name (nom. sg.) coordinated with bhṛgavaḥ; vibhvam "pervading" or "mighty".

hindi: उसकी प्राचीन दीप्ति के अनुसार निर्भय लोगों ने उज्ज्वल दूध दुहा है, सहस्रों को जीतने वाले ऋषि को (दुहकर)।
english: Following his ancient brilliance, the bold ones have milked the bright milk, (milking) the thousand-winning sage.
notes: payaḥ and ṛṣim are both accusatives with duduhre (the double accusative of √duh: to milk X from Y); dyutam is feminine "brilliance". The ᳪ sign in dyutaᳪ is the Vedic anusvara.

hindi: हे अग्नि, तू शरीर का रक्षक है, मेरे शरीर की रक्षा कर। हे अग्नि, तू आयु देने वाला है, मुझे आयु दे। हे अग्नि, तू वर्चस् देने वाला है, मुझे वर्चस् दे। हे अग्नि, मेरे शरीर में जो कमी है, उसे मेरे लिए पूर्ण कर।
english: You are the body-protector, O Agni; protect my body. You are the life-giver, O Agni; give me life. You are the splendour-giver, O Agni; give me splendour. O Agni, what is lacking in my body, fill that up for me.
notes: a̭gne̱ syāyṷrme: agne + asi + āyuḥ + me, printed as "agne syāyur me" with the initial a- of asi elided after -e (the avagraha is not printed here, unlike agne'si in the same line). tanvā ūnam: the visarga of tanvāḥ is dropped before ū-.

words.gram: m. nom. pl. pres. part. mid. √indh

hindi: तुझे सौ वर्षों तक प्रज्वलित करते हुए हम दीप्तिमान को प्रज्वलित करें; वीर्यवान होकर वीर्य करने वाले को, बलवान होकर बल करने वाले को; हे अग्नि, अहिंसित होकर शत्रु-नाशक, अहिंस्य को। हे विचित्र धन वाले, तेरे कल्याण से मैं पार पहुँचूँ।
english: Kindling you for a hundred winters, may we kindle the brilliant one; we full of vigour the vigour-maker, we full of might the might-maker; O Agni, we unharmed the crusher of rivals who cannot be harmed. O you of bright wealth, with your well-being may I reach the far shore.

text_flags.why: possible: the sense and the parallel sahaskṛtam require the accusative vayaskṛtam (object of samidhīmahi, like dyumantam, sahaskṛtam, adābhyam); the printed form lacks the final anusvara.

notes: All the accusatives (dyumantam, vayaskṛtam, sahaskṛtam, sapatnadambhanam, adābhyam) depend on samidhīmahi "may we kindle"; the nominative plurals (vayasvantaḥ, sahasvantaḥ, adabdhāsaḥ) qualify "we". svasti is taken adverbially ("with well-being"); te "your".

hindi: हे अग्नि, तू सूर्य के वर्चस् के साथ, ऋषियों की स्तुति के साथ संयुक्त हुआ है; मैं प्रिय धाम के साथ, आयु के साथ, वर्चस् के साथ, प्रजा के साथ, धन की पुष्टि के साथ संयुक्त होऊँ।
english: You, O Agni, have united with the splendour of the Sun, with the praise of the sages; may I unite with the dear abode, I with life, with splendour, with offspring, with increase of wealth.
notes: sam ... agathāḥ and sam ... gmiṣīya: the preverb sam goes with the verb each time. Two src tokens end in the Vedic anusvara sign followed by a double space (samṛṣīṇāᳪ , saᳪ ); the extra space is kept in src. dhāman may be "abode" or "splendour, nature".

hindi: तुम अन्न हो, मैं तुम्हारे अन्न का भोग करूँ। तुम महत्ता हो, मैं तुम्हारी महत्ता का भोग करूँ। तुम ऊर्जा हो, मैं तुम्हारी ऊर्जा का भोग करूँ। तुम धन की पुष्टि हो, मैं तुम्हारी धन की पुष्टि का भोग करूँ।
english: You are food; may I partake of your food. You are greatness; may I partake of your greatness. You are vigour; may I partake of your vigour. You are increase of wealth; may I partake of your increase of wealth.
notes: andha stha, maha stha, ūrja stha, rāyaspoṣa stha: the visarga of the nominative is dropped before sth- by sandhi. ūrja is taken as the masculine noun ūrja "vigour" (nom. ūrjaḥ, acc. ūrjam); alternatively the consonant stem ūrj.

hindi: हे धनवती (गौओ), इस स्थान में, इस गोष्ठ में, इस लोक में, इस निवास में रमो; यहीं रहो, दूर मत जाओ।
english: O rich ones, abide in this seat, in this cow-pen, in this place, in this dwelling; stay right here; do not go away.
notes: revatī ramadhvam: the visarga of the voc. pl. revatīḥ is dropped before r-. The feminine plural addressees are not named in the line (the cows, by context of goṣṭha, but the text only says "rich ones"). mā apagāta: injunctive with mā.

hindi: तू संहित है, विश्वरूपिणी है; ऊर्जा के साथ, गोपति-भाव के साथ मुझमें प्रवेश कर। हे अग्नि, हे अन्धकार को प्रकाशित करने वाले, दिन-दिन हम बुद्धि के साथ, नमस्कार लिए हुए, तेरे पास आते हैं।
english: You are united, of all forms; with vigour enter into me, with lordship over cows. To you, O Agni, day by day, O illuminer of darkness, we come with prayer, bearing homage.
notes: doṣāvastar: voc. of doṣā-vastṛ, "illuminer of the night/darkness"; the printed -rddh- (doṣāvastarddhiyā) is the usual doubling after r. ema̭si = ā + imasi (Vedic 1 pl. of √i). The first half (saṃhitāsi ... gaupatyena) is addressed to a feminine being; the line does not name her.

words.gram: m. acc. sg. pres. part. mid. √vṛdh

hindi: (हम उसके पास आते हैं जो) यज्ञों पर शासन करता है, ऋत का रक्षक है, दीप्तिमान है, अपने घर में बढ़ता हुआ है।
english: (We come to him) ruling over the rites, the shining guardian of truth, growing in his own house.
notes: GROUPING: the accusatives of this unit continue the sentence of unit 22 (upa tvāgne ... emasi); the edition numbers it separately and that grouping is kept. gopām ṛtasya: visarga-less sandhi of gopām + ṛtasya is regular.

hindi: हे अग्नि, जैसे पिता पुत्र के लिए, वैसे तू हमारे लिए सुलभ हो; कल्याण के लिए हमारे साथ रह।
english: As a father to a son, O Agni, be easy of access to us; stay with us for well-being.
notes: sacasvā shows metrical lengthening of sacasva. saḥ with the imperative bhava: "you, (being) he".

hindi: हे अग्नि, तू हमारा सबसे निकट और त्राता हो, कल्याणकारी, आश्रय देने वाला हो; अग्नि वसु है, उत्तम यश वाला है; इधर आ, अत्यन्त दीप्तिमान धन दे।
english: O Agni, be our nearest one and a protector, kindly and sheltering; Agni is good, of good renown; come hither; give most brilliant wealth.
notes: antama u-: the visarga of antamaḥ is dropped before u-; vasuśravā a-: likewise before a-. bhavā, acchā show metrical lengthening. dāḥ: injunctive used as imperative. The double space after dyumattamaᳪ is kept in src.

words.gloss: from one who seeks to harm

hindi: हे अतिदीप्त, हे प्रकाशमान, उस तुझसे हम अब मित्रों के लिए कृपा की याचना करते हैं; तू हमारी ओर ध्यान दे, हमारी पुकार सुन, हमें हर एक अहित चाहने वाले से बचा।
english: You, O most brilliant, O shining one, we now beseech for favour, for the friends; take notice of us, hear our call, protect us from every one who seeks to harm.

text_flags.why: possible: "adhāyataḥ" gives no sense here; the context (uruṣya "protect ... from") requires aghāyataḥ "from one who intends harm" (denominative of agha); the Devanagari अधा for अघा is a one-letter slip (ध/घ).

notes: śrudhī and uruṣyā show metrical lengthening; ṇo = naḥ with retroflexion after uruṣyā. īmahe: 1 pl. middle of the root ī "to beseech, implore".

hindi: हे इडा, आ; हे अदिति, आ; हे कमनीय (देवियो), आओ। तुम्हारी कामनाओं का धारण मुझमें हो।
english: O Iḍā, come; O Aditi, come; O desirable ones, come. May the holding of your desires be in me.
notes: iḍa ehi, adita ehi: the final -e of the vocatives iḍe, adite becomes -a before e- (Vedic sandhi); ehi = ā + ihi, eta = ā + ita. kāma-dharaṇam "holding/retaining of desire" is translated literally.

hindi: हे ब्रह्मणस्पति, सोम निचोड़ने वाले को यशस्वी बना, जैसे कक्षीवान् को, जो उशिज का पुत्र है।
english: O Brahmaṇaspati, make the Soma-presser resounding, (as you made) Kakṣīvat who is the son of Uśij.
notes: kakṣīvantam: a second object of kṛṇuhi, read as a comparison ("as Kakṣīvat"); the line itself only coordinates the two accusatives. ya au-: yaḥ before au- loses its visarga. The double space after somānaᳪ is kept in src.

hindi: जो धनवान है, जो रोगों का नाश करने वाला है, धन का ज्ञाता है, पुष्टि को बढ़ाने वाला है, जो शीघ्रगामी है, वह हमारे साथ रहे।
english: He who is wealthy, who is the disease-slayer, the wealth-finder, the increaser of prosperity, who is swift, let him attend us.
notes: puṣṭivarddhanaḥ: -rddh- is the usual doubling after r (= vardhanaḥ). siṣaktu is the Vedic reduplicated imperative of √sac.

hindi: हमें न तो कंजूस का शाप और न मर्त्य की दुष्टता पहुँचे; हे ब्रह्मणस्पति, हमारी रक्षा कर।
english: Let not the curse of the hostile one, nor the malice of a mortal, reach us; protect us, O Brahmaṇaspati.

text_flags.why: the Devanagari प्रण॒ङ lacks the virama: the form is praṇak (aor. inj. of pra-√naś) with k > ṅ before the following m- of martyasya; "praṇaṅa" with a final vowel is not a word.

notes: araruṣaḥ: gen. sg. of ararivas/araru "not giving, hostile" (of the demon or the niggard); ṇo = naḥ with retroflexion after rakṣā; rakṣā shows metrical lengthening. The ᳪ in śaᳪso is the Vedic anusvara sign.

hindi: तीनों की — मित्र की, अर्यमा की, वरुण की — महान, स्वर्गीय, दुर्धर्ष सहायता हो।
english: Great be the help of the three, heavenly, of Mitra and of Aryaman, hard to assail, of Varuṇa.
notes: avo 'stu: the visarga of avaḥ becomes o before the elided a- of astu.

hindi: क्योंकि न तो घर में और न ही भयंकर मार्गों पर पाप की बात करने वाला शत्रु उन पर अधिकार रखता है।
english: For neither at home nor on dangerous roads does the evil-speaking enemy have power over them.
notes: teṣām: genitive with īśe ("has power over them"), i.e. over those whom the three gods help (unit 31). vāraṇa "dangerous, wild"; amā cana ... na "neither at home ... nor".
